sections.heading: Characters
mechanicsSummary: Players may switch characters between games.
Before the prologue, create the five starting characters. The other five Character cards are for characters discovered during the campaign.
To create one: take a blank Character card; stick a job into the Job box; stick an image as the photo; write a name and an age; choose one of the named havens as the home.
The Exposure track is scratched as the character gains exposure. Later scratches can reveal scars or a skull. Do not scratch any at creation.
The illustrated Administrator job (an example sticker, not a rule added by this page): once on your turn, as an action, move a pawn onto any other pawn.

diagramsAndCallouts: Character card diagram with fields Name, Photo, Job, Home, Age, Place of Death, and an Exposure scratch track numbered 1–7. Example fill-in: home Asgard, age 36.
Haven tile labeled Asgard with an anchor, pointed at the Home line.
Portrait sticker pointed at the photo box, and an Administrator ability callout pointed at the Job box.
Flavor line at the bottom: the group did not ask to be here and did not want the responsibility.
